raw_segments.text: To oblige every citizen to declare publicly upon oath, the amount of his fortune must
not, it seems, in those Swiss cantons be reckoned a hardship.
At Hamburg it would be reckoned the greatest.
Merchants engaged in the hazardous projects of trade all tremble at the thoughts of being
obliged at all times to expose the real state of their circumstances.
The ruin of their credit and the miscarriage of their projects, they foresee, would too
A sober and parsimonious people, who are strangers to all such projects, do not feel that they
have occasion for any such concealment.
